description: Create or update a named organization-level work schedule (a weekly working-time profile). Provide schedule_id to update an existing one, or omit it to create a new one. weekly_schedule is a JSON object mapping lowercase day names to a working window, e.g. {"monday":{"start":"09:00","end":"18:00"},"saturday":null}. The organization is fixed by your context. On update, only the fields you supply are changed.

default_for_countries.description: Optional comma-separated ISO-2 country codes this profile is the default for, e.g. "US,CA".

first_day_of_week.description: First day of the week: 0=Sunday .. 6=Saturday (1=Monday default).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

is_active.description: Whether the profile is active. Defaults to true on create.

schedule_id.description: Id of an existing schedule to UPDATE. Omit to CREATE a new one.

weekly_schedule.description: A JSON object (as a string) mapping lowercase day names (sunday..saturday) to a {"start":"HH:mm","end":"HH:mm"} window, or null for a non-working day. Example: {"monday":{"start":"09:00","end":"18:00"},"sunday":null}.

name: set_org_work_schedule
